ui.Aucune donnée pour l'instant. Lance le w: No data yet. Run the “Veille quotidienne” workflow.
ui.Mise à jour automatique chaque matin. Le: Updated automatically every morning. Photos and links come from the brands' websites.
ui.Ce qui sort, et à quel rythme: What's coming out, and how fast
ui.Les {days} derniers jours : {n} nouveaut: Last {days} days: {n} new arrivals spotted (excluding the starting catalog).
ui.Pour l'instant, tous les produits suivis: For now, all tracked products ({n}), as there are not enough new arrivals over 7 days. The view will switch to the week automatically.
ui.{n} ont été décrits à partir de leur pho: {n} were described from their photo. Accessories are not counted.
ui.Historique en construction : l'évolution: History in progress: week-over-week changes will appear from the second week of tracking.
ui.Part de chaque type dans les produits de: Share of each type among the products of the period.
ui.Part de chaque type parmi les nouveautés: Share of each type among the new arrivals spotted each week. The “start” is the existing catalog on the first day of tracking: a snapshot, not a week of releases.
ui.Un seul relevé pour l'instant. Les semai: Only one snapshot so far. Following weeks will be added here.
ui.Rythme : nouveautés repérées chaque sema: Pace: new arrivals spotted each week (excluding the starting catalog). Prices: median and range in CAD, excluding sale items, over the products of the period.
ui.Le rythme se calcule à partir de la deux: Pace is calculated from the second week of tracking.
ui.Attention : le dernier taux connu est u: Warning: the last known rate is used; the source did not respond.
ui.Sans taux, exclues des montants en CAD: Without a rate, excluded from CAD amounts: {c}.
ui.Prix courants des produits de la période: Current prices of the period's products, excluding sale items, converted to CAD. The median is the figure to look at: the average is pulled up by a few very expensive pieces. “Typical range”: the middle half of products.
ui.Trop peu de produits pour une médiane fi: Too few products for a reliable median
ui.Prix médian en CAD de chaque marque dans: Median price in CAD of each brand in each type, to see where it stands against the others. At least 3 products are needed in a cell.
ui.Part des produits suivis qui sont vendus: Share of tracked products sold below their crossed-out price. Useful to spot brands already discounting the season (at least 5 products with prices).
ui.Matière dominante vue sur la photo (sati: Dominant material seen in the photo (satin, knit, jersey…), by type, with the number of brands and the median price in CAD when there are at least 4 products. The material is judged by eye: it can confuse satin and silk.
ui.Fibre principale lue dans la composition: Main fiber read from the composition on the product page (for example “95% viscose, 5% elastane”). Only products whose page gives the composition are counted; “blend” = no fiber at 50% or more.
ui.Aucune composition lue pour l'instant :: No composition read yet: it will be picked up at the next collection.
ui.Prix médian en CAD des produits repérés: Median price in CAD of products spotted each week, at the current rate for all weeks, so an exchange-rate change is not mistaken for a price rise. Sale items excluded, at least 3 products per cell.
ui.Un seul relevé pour l'instant : les sema: Only one snapshot so far: following weeks will be added here.
ui.Une couleur, matière, longueur, coupe, e: A color, material, length, cut, neckline, shape, style or detail found at 3 or more different brands over the period, on at least 3 products.
ui.Aucune tendance pour l'instant : il faut: No trend yet: the same attribute is needed at 3 brands and on 3 products.
ui.Pour l'instant, ce sont les attributs le: For now, these are the most widespread attributes among the tracked brands. The gap with the previous week (points, or “new”) will appear from the second week, and it is what signals a real trend.
ui.Les chiffres sont calculés à chaque mise: Figures are recalculated at each update from the tracked products. Dates are those on which each product was first spotted.
